title: Qi is an operational latent-state representation in Paper 1
claim: For Paper 1, qi is operationally represented as a latent state used to formalize repeated directional and relational properties in the source corpus; this does not assert that qi is an experimentally established physical energy.
maturity_note: The operational definition is explicit in PROJECT_CONSTITUTION.md and D-002/D-012. The ontology's specific candidate dimensions remain revisable.
wording_ceiling: Use 'operational latent-state representation'; do not describe qi as a proven physical substance or mechanism.
limitations: Modern mathematical layer names are research normalization.
Specific ontology dimensions and interaction functions are not all final.
